task_description:
Feature Request: Add npub as Identifier in Notification Settings

Description
The current notification settings UI for the “Nostr” option in LNbits does not support using npub (Nostr public keys) as an identifier.
To fully enable Nostr-based notifications, LNbits should allow users to enter and save an npub identifier, and the backend should be updated accordingly to handle it.

This request includes:
	•	Allowing npub input in the notification settings form.
	•	Validating the given npub value.
	•	Fetching and storing the user’s relay list associated with that npub for delivering notifications via Nostr.
	•	Updating documentation as needed to reflect this capability.

Why This Is Valuable
Support for Nostr identifiers (npub) in notifications will:
	1.	Enable more flexible and standards-aligned Nostr support.
	2.	Allow users to receive LNbits notifications directly via their Nostr public keys.
	3.	Improve LNbits interoperability with decentralized identity tooling in the Nostr ecosystem.

Expected Behavior
When a user selects Nostr in the notification settings:
	•	They should be able to enter an npub value.
	•	The system should validate the format and retrieve the associated relay list.
	•	Notification deliveries should correctly use the configured npub and relays.

Steps to Reproduce / Implement
	1.	Extend the notifications settings UI to allow input for npub.
	2.	Add validation logic for the npub format (e.g., length and prefix checks).
	3.	On saving settings, fetch the user’s relay list from Nostr (via relevant libraries or HTTP endpoints).
	4.	Store the relay list and npub in the user’s notification preferences.
	5.	Update backend notification dispatch logic to use npub and relay list when sending Nostr notifications.
	6.	Add tests covering the new input and relay handling.

Additional Context
This feature was initially raised in issue #3403 and linked discussion #3382 for clarifications on Nostr support.  ￼
